name: new-study
when: Setting up a study: dataset, queries, candidate sampling, grouping, labels, team.

steps.title: 1 · Dataset
steps.text: A dataset added on the command line.

steps.title: 2 · Queries
steps.text: One of its query sets: image, text or image + text queries, all or a random sample.

steps.title: 3 · Candidate sampling
steps.text: How each query's pool is drawn: its given candidates, the nearest neighbours of one or more encoders (each to its own depth), or a random sample. Show embeddings lists what each encoder has embedded, and the command for what is missing.

steps.title: 4 · Grouping
steps.text: The encoder that groups every pool, or none to judge every image on its own.

steps.title: 5 · Labels
steps.text: Relevant and Not Relevant; Unsure is optional.

steps.title: 6 · Name and team
steps.text: Annotators judge, adjudicators set the final labels where annotators disagree, other admins help manage. Creating the study builds and groups the pools; the guidelines come next.
